task_completion.description: Open the Firefox Developer Tools and navigate to the Memory panel.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Firefox DevTools pane is visible with the 'Memory' tab selected/active.
A snapshot entry appears in the left sidebar of the Memory panel, typically labeled 'Snapshot 1'.

task_completion.description: Save the baseline snapshot to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save' button/icon is clicked for the first snapshot, and a file dialog or confirmation shows the path ~/Documents/baseline.fxsnapshot.

task_completion.description: Interact with the app by clicking 'Load High-Res Gallery' then 'Destroy Gallery'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cursor is seen clicking the 'Load High-Res Gallery' button, followed by the 'Destroy Gallery' button in the web page area.

task_completion.description: Take the second heap snapshot after the interaction.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A second snapshot entry (e.g., 'Snapshot 2') appears in the Memory panel sidebar.

task_completion.description: Save the second snapshot to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save' button/icon is clicked for the second snapshot, and a file dialog or confirmation shows the path ~/Documents/leaked.fxsnapshot.

integrity.description: The agent used the Firefox GUI to capture and save snapshots rather than CLI commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the DevTools 'Take snapshot' and 'Save' buttons.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the buttons inside the localhost:8080 webpage.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser viewport shows the 'Load High-Res Gallery' and 'Destroy Gallery' buttons being highlighted or clicked.

integrity.description: The agent did not use a terminal to 'touch' or create dummy snapshot files.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory does not show a terminal window being used to create files in ~/Documents.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires using the Firefox DevTools Memory panel specifically. The baseline snapshot must be taken before clicking the gallery buttons. The 'Load High-Res Gallery' button must be clicked before 'Destroy Gallery'. Files should be saved to ~/Documents/; Firefox may append an extra .fxsnapshot extension (e.g., baseline.fxsnapshot.fxsnapshot), which is acceptable per instructions.
